_comment: Deterministic claim-verification benchmark. Feed source_text to the verifier as the only fetched source, feed model_answer as the stubbed Gemini reply, and require the expected statuses, quote verification, and locations. This is the regression contract for the deterministic half of verify(): schema validation, quote checking, and location mapping must hold no matter what the model layer does.
claims: Alexander became king of Macedon in 336 BC.
Alexander died in Babylon in 323 BC.
Alexander had a sister named Cleopatra.
Alexander's empire stretched from Greece to India and he ruled it until his death.
